page.notes: The Hebrew is copied as closely as the scan allows. Uncertain Hebrew forms are not marked individually: the entry at "מוֹלַדְתֵּךְ" and the Hebrew before "pasti" at the top of the left column (cut off, so the entry is a fragment) are doubtful. The page number at top left ("332") is blurred and marked [?]. The running head is read from the Hebrew headers and may be inexact. The first paragraph of the left column continues from the previous page. The left column's last entry runs over into the right column ("tua" / "tuæ") and is kept as two paragraphs, the second marked cont="true".
